$comment: Every ERC-20 move written in src/ outside src/libraries/LibDelivery.sol, with the reason it may skip the library (#2440). Read by contracts/script/check-measured-delivery.mjs, which fails on an unlisted move, a changed count, or a stale entry. Keyed <file>:<Contract>.<function>.

sites.reason: Principal-only sweep of the adapter's own raw balance to its single principal. It books nothing: the balance is outside totalAssets, so whatever arrives is simply the principal's.

VPFI interaction-rewards forwarder. VPFI reward custody is outside #2440's scope (owned by the reward-custody work); VPFI is the protocol's own token and charges no transfer fee. The backstop's other forwards to the treasury are measured (LibDelivery.pushMeasured).
The reward-custody holder's Diamond-only release. The Diamond side measures each release (LibRewardCustody). Reward custody is outside #2440's scope.
Vault primitive with no caller in src/: every deposit into a vault is a LibDelivery move by the Diamond straight to the vault's address. Owner-only.

Vault primitive behind its Diamond-only gate. Its callers, VaultFactoryFacet.vaultWithdrawERC20 and the stuck-token recovery, measure what the recipient received and refuse a move that cost the vault more than it sent.

Swap adapter leg. Every adapter call runs inside a LibSwap attempt that the Diamond measures as a whole from its own balances, and an attempt that delivers less than it reported is unwound and the next route tried (#2472, SwapAttemptFacet).

Cross-chain receiver forwarding a CCIP-delivered token to the Diamond. It reads the Diamond's balance around its own move and books the measured figure (actualReceived). VPFI recycling and reward transport, outside #2440's scope.
CCIP messenger forwarding delivered tokens to the registered handler, which measures what reached the Diamond. Cross-chain transport, outside #2440's scope.
CCIP messenger pulling a protocol sender's tokens for the router to lock or burn. It books nothing at the messenger. Cross-chain transport, outside #2440's scope.

VPFI LIF rebate payout on the grandfathered peg-custody path (#1352): a recorded rebate paid in VPFI, the protocol's own token, which charges no transfer fee. VPFI fee custody is outside #2440's scope.
VPFI repatriation of a stranded return. VPFI recycling is outside #2440's scope (owned by the recycling work).
VPFI reward claim paid to the claimant's wallet (a payout of a recorded claim books nobody by what arrives). Reward custody is outside #2440's scope.

Credit of a VPFI reward or rebate into a user's vault. Every caller passes VPFI (LibVPFIDiscount, LibRewardStaging, RewardClaimFacet), the protocol's own token, which charges no transfer fee. VPFI reward paths are outside #2440's scope.
Standalone keeper liquidator repaying its flash loan from its own balance. Not protocol custody and books nothing in the protocol; keeper code is owned by the keeper work.
Owner withdrawal of the standalone keeper liquidator's own balance. Not protocol custody and books nothing in the protocol; keeper code is owned by the keeper work.
Low-level VPFI keeper-reward transfer; its caller takes the recipient's balance delta as the success signal. Keeper rewards are owned by the keeper work, outside #2440's scope.
Reward-custody funding pull into the holder. It reads the holder's balance around the move and books what arrived. Reward custody is outside #2440's scope.
Reward-custody move from the Diamond into the holder. It reads both balances around the move and books what arrived. Reward custody is outside #2440's scope.
VPFI reward claim paid to the claimant's wallet (a payout of a recorded claim books nobody by what arrives). Reward custody is outside #2440's scope.
Service-capacity arming fee pulled from the operator into the Diamond; the recycle-bucket credit it feeds measures the ingress by balance delta itself (creditServiceCapacityArmingFee).
Service-capacity deposit pull, measured on the destination and refused unless all of it arrived (ServiceCapacityMoveUnverified).
VPFI LIF forfeit to the treasury on the grandfathered peg-custody path (#1352), in VPFI, the protocol's own token, which charges no transfer fee. VPFI fee custody is outside #2440's scope.
VPFI LIF treasury share on the grandfathered peg-custody path (#1352), in VPFI, the protocol's own token, which charges no transfer fee. VPFI fee custody is outside #2440's scope.
VPFI recycling release on the pre-holder path. VPFI recycling is outside #2440's scope (owned by the recycling work).
Owner-only recovery of tokens stranded on the listing executor. It books nothing, so there is no figure a reading would protect.
